author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween hoodie design
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13" × 16"); neon green, purple & orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing existing designs). Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Follow-up from author: Must be an Adobe Illustrator. Please DM if available. Contact: reply on the post or DM @temmycreative_.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator. Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. For character art: gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, with potential for more if the style fits the series. For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if interested or DM directly. Follow-up (2026-09-22): author is reviewing portfolios and asked anyone who has not sent a portfolio to share a link to previous work. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.

author: Allie Higdem
title: Author needs non-AI character art
content: I need character art! I'm a little late to the game and would love any recommendations for budget friendly artists that do not use A.I and have availability now/within the next couple months. #authorthreads #bookthreads. Contact: reply on the post or DM @alliehigdem.author.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for client visuals
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, and simple visual adaptations/resizing. Prefer someone with a good eye for clean and modern design, who can follow brand guidelines/references, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Freelance/project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects. Drop portfolio + rate in the comments or DM. Contact: comment or DM @yuanxin_289.
